workable.notes: Workable's public job-board search API, filtered server-side to workplace=remote and location=us. Added October 21, 2026 because it is where the part-time, contract and freelance writing, editing, SEO, marketing and admin work actually lives, and because Workable hosts the employer's own application form, so there is no board account wall. Every row carries the employer name, the engagement type, the posting date and its own job page. Pay is printed in the description or benefits block and parsed from there.

alignerr.notes: EXCLUDED BY VINNY, Oct 25 2026: he does not want jobs from Alignerr, and the host is blocklisted in rules.json so no Alignerr row can pass prefilter even if it reaches raw.jsonl through some other path. Do not re-enable this source. Kept only so the adapter name is not silently reused.

smartrecruiters.notes: SmartRecruiters' public job search, one keyword per request. The endpoint IGNORES every paging parameter (verified October 25, 2026), so depth comes from keyword breadth: the baseline walks the term lists, the top-up round expands them with engagement and seniority modifiers. SmartRecruiters hosts the employer's own application form (careers.<company> / jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<company>), so every row is direct-apply with no account wall, the same class as Workable and the employer ATS boards. Added October 25, 2026 after the Workable search endpoint rate-limited for the third straight morning and Alignerr was excluded. Rows are filtered to fully remote US postings in his job families inside the freshness window before any detail read; pay comes from the posting's detail record (compensation field or jobAd text).

remoteok.notes: Fresh, fast-moving board with salary fields. Links back to remoteok.com job page; some postings expose a direct apply URL in extra.apply_url_hint.

remotive.notes: Salary and candidate_required_location present. Search via &search=<term>.

jobicy.notes: EXCLUDED BY VINNY, Oct 18 2026: every jobicy job page demanded an account signup and data collection before the employer form, and he will not spend 30-60 minutes creating accounts to collect spam. Do not re-enable this source. Kept only so the adapter is not silently reused.

himalayas.notes: Richest pay data (minSalary/maxSalary/salaryPeriod) plus locationRestrictions for US eligibility.

wwr.notes: Only the root feed is enabled. Category feeds return 403 and parse errors, and Vinny put them on the dead list on October 18, 2026, so do not spend research time on them. WWR also account-walls most listings, so only postings whose feed body carries the employer link survive verification.

workingnomads.notes: Free exposed_jobs feed with company_name, tags, location, pub_date. No pay field, so pay has to be found elsewhere or flagged.

arbeitnow.notes: Europe-weighted but carries a remote flag and job_types. Low yield for US-remote roles, cheap to include.

nodesk.notes: Curated remote list, low volume, decent pay disclosure.

jobspresso.notes: Low volume, occasionally good writing and marketing roles.

whoishiring.notes: Latest Ask HN: Who is hiring thread comments. High contract and freelance density, often founder-direct with an email to apply. Thread is monthly, so freshness must be checked against the comment text, not the thread.

ats.notes: Employer ATS boards from config/companies.json (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever). Every posting carries the employer's own application URL, which is the only apply path Vinny will accept. Remote rows only, capped per employer by params.ats_per_company.
